title: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 Review: A Themed Race with Unusual Distances
seo_title: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 Review | Tangerang Indonesia
meta_description: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026: September 27 at Summarecon Mall Serpong. 21K, 12K, 7K, 5K with registration open — a themed Indonesian race with distinctive distances.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 at Summarecon Mall Serpong in Tangerang Selatan, this 'warrior'-themed run offers an unusual distance spread (21K, 12K, 7K, 5K) with registration open.
verdict: The Serpong Warrior Challenge Run stands out for its distance spread: 21K, 12K, 7K, and 5K — none of the standard 10K pairing. The 'warrior' theme adds a distinctive character to what is otherwise a mall-anchored race in Serpong, a satellite city southwest of Jakarta with a growing running community. Registration is open. For Jakarta-area runners wanting a themed half marathon with unusual distance options, this is a distinctive pick.

sections.heading: Warrior Theme, Warrior Distances
paragraphs: The 12K and 7K distances are genuinely unusual — bridging gaps between the standard 5K, 10K, and 21K. [1] Summarecon Mall Serpong provides a practical race hub in Tangerang Selatan, roughly 45 minutes southwest of central Jakarta.
